description: WhatsApp is testing third-party agent chats on iOS through beta version 26.37.10.70, according to WABetaInfo. The feature allow users to create agents in WhatsApp and connect them to external services using an API key. Users could create up to five agents and chat with them directly in the app. These conversations do not use end-to-end encryption, as Meta handles the messages through its service for agent developers. The feature remains limited to select countries and a small number of users.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Brings Third-Party Agent Chats to iOS Beta Users

description: ChatGPT has started rolling out a new Privacy Center. The new option shows what various privacy controls do and provides direct links to manage them within ChatGPT. The Privacy Centre organises related features into three categories. Select a category. Privacy Center is rolling out to signed-in ChatGPT Free, Go, Plus, Pro, and Business users on the web and in the ChatGPT apps for iOS and Android. This rollout does not include ChatGPT Enterprise, Edu, or ChatGPT for Healthcare.
title: ChatGPT Gets New Privacy Center With Easy Access to Privacy Controls: Here's How to Use it

description: Whitehat researchers have moved 52.37 BTC linked to the July Coldcard wallet exploit into an address associated with the Crypto Recovery Trust. Galaxy Digital Research Head Alex Thorn said the Bitcoin came from several tracked exploit clusters and represented 2.8 percent of the funds monitored by his team. The trust is designed to hold recovered digital assets while ownership claims are reviewed before eligible funds are returned.
title: Coldcard Whitehats Transfer Stolen 52.37 BTC to Recovery Trust

description: Samsung could equip most Galaxy S27 series models with 12GB RAM, according to a new leak, while the Galaxy S27 Ultra may offer 16GB RAM with 1TB storage. The Galaxy S27 Pro and Ultra could also move to LPDDR6 RAM and UFS 5.1 storage, although Samsung has yet to finalise these components. Other reported upgrades include the Exynos 2700 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipsets, M16 OLED panels for the Pro and Ultra, and M14 panels for the standard models.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27, S27 Plus, S27 Pro, S27 Ultra RAM and Storage Details Leaked Online

description: Oppo Find X10, Find X10 E, and Find X10 Pro Max have been launched in China, the company announced on Tuesday. Oppo’s new smartphones are set to go on sale in China on September 24 via the Oppo online store. The Oppo Find X10 is offered in Light Titanium, Ice Blue, and Qingcheng (translated from Chinese) colour options. However, the Find X10 E will not ship in the Qingcheng shade. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max will be available for purchase in Light Titanium, Moon White, and Warm Orange colourways.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max Launched With Triple 200-Megapixel Cameras, Alongside Oppo Find X10, X10 E: Price, Specifications

description: The HP HyperX Omen 16 Valorant Edition has a premium design language. The laptop packs a 16-inch 2.5K IPS display that offers decent colours. It also features a powerful AMD Ryzen 9 9955HX processor for strong performance, while the Nvidia GeForce RTX 5070 delivers a seamless gaming experience.
title: HP HyperX Omen 16 Valorant Edition Review: A Powerful Laptop Built to Game

description: MediaTek Dimensity CX C10 Max was launched on Tuesday as the first processor under the Taiwan-based chipmaker’s Dimensity Compute Experiences (CX) family. It is a flagship computing platform aimed at premium, ultra-portable Googlebook devices. The processor is fabricated on a 3nm process and features an octa-core CPU, an 11-core GPU, and MediaTek’s NPU 890. MediaTek claims the CX C10 Max supports fanless designs with all-day battery life, while the built-in AI engine can power Gemini Intelligence and on-device agentic AI workloads.
title: MediaTek Dimensity CX C10 Max Platform Launched With 55 TOPS NPU for AI-Powered Googlebook Devices

description: Google has revealed details about the Googlebook models from Asus, Acer, HP, Dell, and Lenovo, namely Acer Googlebook 14, Asus Googlebook 14, HP Googlebook 14, Dell XPS Googlebook, and Lenovo Googlebook 15, respectively. All laptops are now available for pre-order via the company website. The laptops ship with the new Googlebook OS, which is claimed to integrate the features of Android into ChromeOS. The laptops also feature backlit keyboards.
title: Asus, Acer and HP Googlebook 14 Announced Alongside Dell XPS Googlebook, Lenovo Googlebook 15: Price, Features

description: X has launched the US Cashtag Partner Program, allowing users to move from stock, ETF, and cryptocurrency pages to participating trading platforms. Coinbase, Kraken, Gemini, Interactive Brokers and Moomoo are among the launch partners. X will display asset prices, charts, and related posts before directing users to the selected provider’s app or website, where account authentication and trade execution take place.
title: X Launches Cashtag Partner Programme With Coinbase, Gemini, Kraken and Other Trading Platforms

description: HMD has teased the launch of a new Pro smartphone in India. It is likely to come with HMD Pro moniker. The teaser carries the tagline “Pro is about to focus on one thing: your Vibe” and asks users to guess “what's behind the lens,” hinting that new camera features could be introduced with the new smartphone. It is likely to come with dual rear camera unit. The HMD Pro will be available for purchase through Flipkart.
title: HMD Pro India Confirmed to Launch in India Soon; Flipkart Availability Confirmed

description: The Indian government has brought smartphone screen protectors under its compulsory registration framework, with the new requirement set to apply from April 1, 2027. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology has specified IS 19348:2025 as the applicable Indian Standard. The standard covers glass quality, dimensions and strength, along with features such as adhesives, anti-shatter films, oleophobic and anti-glare coatings, blue-light filtering and privacy layers. The new framework could affect product availability and add testing and certification costs for businesses.
title: India to Enforce BIS Registration Rules for Smartphone Screen Protectors From April 2027

description: Bharti Airtel announced new benefits included with its family postpaid plans in India on Tuesday. The telecom service provider has added Apple’s iCloud+, Apple TV and Apple Arcade to postpaid plans priced at Rs. 999 and above. Airtel said that the updated plans combine connectivity with digital entertainment and other services for families. They offer cloud storage, access to Apple’s streaming service, and a catalogue of games under the same offering.
title: Airtel Adds iCloud+, Apple TV and Arcade to Rs. 999 and Above Family Postpaid Plans

description: The iQOO Z11 Lite 5G is now available in a new 4GB RAM + 64GB storage variant in India, and it is listed for Rs. 17,499 on Amazon India. However, a promotional banner on the e-commerce platform shows an effective price of Rs. 15,999. The handset was launched in July. It runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset and has a 6.74-inch display. The iQOO Z11 Lite 5G has a 50-megapixel primary rear camera and a 6,500mAh battery.
title: iQOO Z11 Lite 5G Gets New 4GB RAM, 64GB Storage Variant in India: Price, Availability

description: c According to reports, the iPhone 16 is expected to be offered at a discounted price of under Rs. 70,000. This would mark a price cut of about Rs. 20,000, as the iPhone 16 currently retails at Rs. 89,999. Meanwhile, the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra could be offered at an effective price of under Rs. 85,000. However, these figures could include card discounts, cashback, and exchange bonuses.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale Offers, Discounts on iPhone 16, Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra and More Teased

description: Oppo has revised the prices of the Reno 16c, A6 5G, A6x 5G and A6c in India. The Reno 16c now costs up to Rs. 62,999, while the top-end A6 5G configuration is priced at Rs. 35,999. The A6x 5G and A6c have also become more expensive across their respective variants. The updated prices are already listed on Oppo's India website. The changes come amid price increases from several smartphone brands, with rising memory and component costs cited as a possible factor.
title: Oppo Reportedly Hikes Reno 16c, A6 5G, A6x 5G, A6c Prices in India by Up to Rs. 4,000

description: Vu Ultra Large TV series has been launched in India. The new Vu Ultra Large TV series is equipped with up to a 100-inch 4K UHD (3,840 x 2,160 pixels) QLED direct-lit panel, which delivers up to 500 nits peak brightness and 94 percent DCI-P3 wide colour gamut. On top of this, the new Vu Ultra Large TV range offers up to a 120Hz native refresh rate, up to 240Hz High-Speed Refresh (HSR), and up to 144Hz variable refresh rate (VRR), along with Motion Estimation and Motion Compensation (MEMC), Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM), and a dedicated Game Mode.
title: Vu Ultra Large Smart TV Series Launched in India in 85-Inch, 100-Inch 4K QLED Display Options: Price, Specifications

description: Bitcoin has climbed above $85,000 after breaking through key resistance, supported by stronger spot ETF inflows, institutional buying, and short covering. More than $746 million in crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours, while easing Treasury yields and oil prices have improved the broader macro backdrop. Analysts are now watching whether Bitcoin can hold above the $82,000-$82,800 zone.
title: Bitcoin Climbs Above $85,000 as ETF Inflows and Short Covering Lift Market

description: OnePlus N6 Lite 4G has been launched in India. It comes in two shades and packs a 7,000mAh battery and supports 15W wired charging. It has a 6.75-inch HD+ display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It runs on a Unisoc chipset paired with 4GB of RAM and 64GB of storage. It features a 13,700 sq mm heat dissipation area.
title: OnePlus N6 Lite 4G Launched in India With 6.75-Inch Display, 7,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Nothing has announced that it is expanding its strategic partnership with the Optiemus Group to bring manufacturing, ownership, and research and development of Nothing and CMF smartphones under one India-based entity, CMF. Further, the company says that the partnership between Nothing and the Optiemus Group for the CMF brand will allow the firms to bring manufacturing, ownership, and research and development under the purview of a single Indian-owned entity, which is CMF.
title: Carl Pei’s Masterstroke: How CMF is Turbocharging Its R&D With Optiemus in India

description: In a major studio udpate, Bungie said it would bring back Destiny 2 and committed to developing new stories and experiences for the game. The studio also announced it would restore vaulted content to the game. Additionally, Bungie said it would evolve Marathon so it could reach more players.
title: Bungie Announces Plan to Bring Back Destiny 2 and Evolve Marathon as Part of Studio's 'Next Chapter'

description: Department of Telecommunications (DoT) has warned mobile subscribers against allowing other people to use SIM cards registered in their names. Fraudulent SIM issuance and tampering with telecom identifiers can lead to legal action. Under the Telecommunications Act, 2023, violations involving fraudulent SIM procurement and IMEI tampering can carry a jail term of up to three years and a fine of up to Rs. 50 lakh.
title: DoT Warns of Up to Rs. 50 Lakh Fine, Up to 3 Years' Imprisonment for Fraudulent SIMs and IMEI Tampering

description: Vivo V80 will be launched in India next month, the company announced on Tuesday. The handset is expected to arrive as the successor to the V70, which was introduced in February this year. The handset is confirmed to feature a Zeiss-branded camera setup with a 50-megapixel primary shooter and a dedicated telephoto camera. It is teased to sport a 144Hz OLED display and run on OriginOS 7. The Vivo V80 will pack a 7,200mAh battery.
title: Vivo V80 India Launch Date Announced; Display, Camera, Battery Specifications Revealed

description: OnePlus China President Li Jie Louis has released more details about the company’s upcoming flagship. The OnePlus 16 will feature a flat, minimalist design with ultra-thin display bezels. The executive also explained the phone’s shortcut key and its preset functions.
title: OnePlus 16 to Feature Ultra-Thin Bezels as New Display and Design Details Emerge

description: Samsung has announced rollout dates for One UI 9 on several Galaxy devices, starting with the Galaxy S25 series, Galaxy Z Fold 7 and Galaxy Z Flip 7 in Thailand on September 28. The Galaxy S23 FE is scheduled to receive the update in October. One UI 9 also brings new functionality to Galaxy devices, including improved camera tracking, customisable daily summaries, translation tools and document scanning. Samsung is expanding security features as well, with enhanced privacy alerts and broader Scam Detection support.
title: Samsung's One UI 9 Update Rollout Date Confirmed for Galaxy S25, Galaxy Z Fold 7 and Z Flip 7

description: With the festive season around, it's that time of year again. And, if Amazon India is to be believed, prices during the Great Indian Festival 2026 will be the best of the year for electronics, as memory and chip costs are expected to continue rising. Gadgets 360 spoke to Zeba Khan, Director, Consumer Electronics, Amazon India, ahead of the festive sale kick-off to get an idea of the trends the e-commerce giant is chasing this year.
title: Buy Now Or Pay More Later: Amazon Says Great Indian Festival Sale Prices Are 2026’s Lowest for Electronics

description: Wozoyo Plans Over 100 New Products by December, CEO Reveals Upcoming Categories.
title: 100 New Products, UK Expansion and a $500 Million Goal: Inside Wozoyo's Big Plans

description: Onimusha: Way of the Sword marks the return of Capcom’s long-dormant samurai series, with Miyamoto Musashi leading the charge through a demon-infested Kyoto. The story is fairly straightforward, but Musashi’s wit and swagger make him an enjoyable protagonist. The real highlight is the combat, with its timing-based Issen system delivering satisfying swordplay.
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Review — Swordplay Sorcery

description: Oppo A7 Pro Max is now available in select global markets. The latest Oppo A series phone comes in two colour options and runs on a Qualcomm Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset. The Oppo A7 Pro Max houses a 10,000mAh battery with 80W charging support. It has a 50-megapixel primary rear camera alongside a 2-megapixel monochrome sensor. For selfies and video calls, the smartphone has a 50-megapixel front camera.
title: Oppo A7 Pro Max Launched With 10,000mAh Battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo Watch 6 has debuted in China with Bluetooth and eSIM connectivity options, including a premium titanium alloy variant. The smartwatch features a sapphire crystal display, IP68 and 5ATM water resistance, and supports health and fitness tracking. It also offers offline maps, route navigation and more than 100 sports modes. Vivo claims up to 21 days of battery life with light use. The wearable runs Blue OS 4.0 and supports NFC, while the eSIM version enables calls and other standalone functions.
title: Vivo Watch 6 Announced With 3,500nits AMOLED Display, Up to 21 Days Battery Life: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo has started rolling out the Android 17-based Origin OS 7 update to select devices globally. In a press release, Vivo announced that the latest Android 17-based OriginOS 7 update will start rolling out on Monday to select Vivo and iQOO devices enrolled in the OriginOS 7 Preview Programme in India, Thailand, and Malaysia. First, the update will be rolled out to the Vivo X300 Pro and “select iQOO devices”. Later, the software will be released to the Vivo X500 series and the new Vivo X Fold, along with the V lineup.
title: Vivo Android 17-Based OriginOS 7 Announced Globally With Jovi AI Assistant, Dynamic Glow Design and More

description: Ahead of its official launch in China, Xiaomi has released a post with details about the 18 Pro’s rear cameras. The Xiaomi 18 Pro is shown to have two 200-megapixel rear cameras. Its primary camera uses a large 1/1.28-inch sensor, while the periscope telephoto camera has a 1/1.56-inch sensor. The telephoto camera supports up to 3.2X optical zoom.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Camera Details Revealed Ahead of September 23 Launch: What You Need to Know

description: The Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale is all set to take place in the second week of October. In recent days, the e-commerce giant has been teasing the early bird offers customers will be able to grab before the sale’s wider commencement. Among the most notable early deals teased by Flipkart will be on the iPhone 17. The teaser also suggests that the handset could be offered with significant discounts, with the deal also combined with additional payment offers.
title: iPhone 17 Deal Teased Below Rs. 80,000 During Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale

description: Google on Monday announced Googlebook as a new class of laptops that combine Android’s technology stack with the desktop experience of ChromeOS. According to the Mountain View-based tech giant, these devices are built around Gemini Intelligence and are designed to work closely with Android smartphones. Googlebook laptops from partners like Acer, Asus, Dell, and more feature up to 2.8K OLED displays, dedicated NPUs, premium materials, and up to 14 hours of battery life.
title: Googlebook Laptops Announced With Gemini Intelligence, Android Integration: Price, Features

description: Reliance Jio and T-Mobile have announced the achievement of what the companies describe as the world's first 5G Standalone (SA) roaming connection. The milestone, realised by the Indian telecom service provider and the US-based wireless network operator, is said to mark a significant step towards interoperable 5G networks across countries. It allows T-Mobile customers travelling internationally to access 5G SA roaming through Jio's network in India. The technology is claimed to deliver faster speeds, lower latency, and more reliable connectivity compared with earlier roaming setups.
title: Jio and T-Mobile Achieve World’s First 5G SA Roaming Connection With Syniverse
